request.input:
3girls, 2boys, five adult adventurers sharing dinner after returning home, communal dining table, steaming stew, bread, small cake, intimate candid ensemble, all five faces clear

One continuous wide story illustration for five adjacent save-slot windows, not five separate panels.

Left to right: silver ponytail woman sitting and secretly reaching for the central woman's cake; bespectacled silver-haired man standing behind the table pouring tea; brown-haired woman sitting with a fork raised to stop the theft; muscular dark-skinned man standing carrying a steaming stew pot; blonde woman sitting sideways and offering her empty bowl to him. Alternating seated and standing heights, lively connected eye-lines and hands. Slightly elevated medium-wide camera, long table diagonals lead inward. Faces near horizontal positions 10%,30%,50%,70%,90%; keep faces out of the seams. No spectators.

Warm hanging amber lamp and low hearth illuminate faces, fingers, ceramic bowls and rising steam; deep cool blue winter night behind a closed window with a few snowflakes. Warm light against cool shadow, focused face planes, foreground cutlery and a folded map, lived-in safehouse dining room, clear depth.
